title: SQL Injection (MySQL)
description: SQL injection in the username parameter of the login form. Time-based blind injection confirmed via extended response delay.
reproduction_steps: Submit username=admin' AND SLEEP(5)-- and any password.

remediation.summary: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements for all user-supplied input in authentication queries.
remediation.patch_recommendation: Replace string-concatenated SQL in AuthRepository with parameterized statements.
